name: contentful-akamai-lambda
description: AWS Lambda: Sync Contentful content to Akamai NetStorage

scripts.deploy: npm run build && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name contentful-to-akamai --zip-file fileb://function.zip
scripts.build: zip -r function.zip index.js contentful-client.js akamai-client.js node_modules package.json
